scope: Paired complete toy degree-19 index-calculus timing with verified unknown-scalar recovery

shared_configuration.solver: in-tree CDCL with native XOR rows

optimized.name: optimized
optimized.early_stop_guard: candidate scalar must reproduce the public target point

admission: both arms use identical curve, factor-base points, target, sampler seed, target order, SAT encoding, and conflict budget
both arms recover the planted unknown scalar and independently reproduce the public target
any invalid SAT model rejects the run
UNKNOWN is an inconclusive skipped target and never a refutation or relation
internal end-to-end time must agree with external real time within two percent
the optimized arm must beat the control in every pair
claim_boundary: Measured end-to-end constant-factor speedup for the recorded toy degree-19 SAT index-calculus implementation; no exponent improvement, Pollard-rho comparison, global factor-base optimum, or deployed-curve security claim
